title: Waking with three bruises on the arm after an expected visitation

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, says that in 2013 in Fort Collins, Colorado, he was expecting a visitation and woke to find three bruises on his arm. He tells Michels it happened to him, as part of his account of being abducted by an alien, and the bruises would be physical traces of that contact if it happened as he says.
